text:
Maya: Quick design review — pushed updated billing dashboard frames to Figma https://www.figma.com/file/xxx. Focus: org vs project default, invoice CTA placement, and token breakdown microcopy. PTAL before EOD.
Jared: Love the header sparkline, but axis labels are hard to read at small widths — can we bump the font or hide minor ticks?
Priya: Agree. Suggest compressing the label (e.g., '4.2M tokens') instead of showing full '4,200,000 tokens' at narrow breakpoints.
Ethan: Org vs project default logic question: should admins default to org and devs default to project? Where do we draw the line?
Sasha: Remembering last-used per-user feels friendlier than guessing role-based defaults. Avoid surprising admins who mostly look at project-level.
Priya: Accessibility nit — the toggle contrast (#F6F8FA on #FFFFFF) fails 3:1 for low-vision users. Need to increase contrast or add a visible focus ring.
Maya: Good catch — I'll update color tokens. Also: invoice CTA — do we want per-row 'Download' buttons or a global bulk download in the header? Current mock shows per-row.
Jared: Keep per-row for quick one-offs, but add a bulk download option in the header (checkbox select + "Download invoices") for accounting workflows.
Ethan: Microcopy tweak: change "Download invoice" -> "Download PDF invoice" for clarity (customers sometimes expect CSV).
Sasha: Token breakdown chart: stacked bar labels overlap at small sizes. Proposal: hide inline labels under 480px, show hover tooltip instead, and add a compact legend toggle.
Priya: Also, don't mix token counts and compute-minutes in the same axis. If we must show both, use a dual-axis with clear unit labels. Mixing units hides signal.
Maya: Noted — will separate or use dual-axis with explicit unit badges.
Jared: UX small: move the units label inline to the right of the numeric value (e.g., "4.2M tokens") rather than inside the axis to save space.
Sasha: +1 for that. Also add aria-labels on the download buttons and ensure keyboard focus shows a 3px solid ring.
Maya: Example aria pattern I'll add: `aria-label="Download invoice PDF for 2024-06-01-INV-12345"`. Will push update.
DesignBot: accessibility-check: colorContrast=fail on .scope-toggle; missing aria-label on .invoice-download for screen readers.
Maya: Thanks @DesignBot — adding aria-labels and bumping the toggle contrast token. Will also include notes in the figma spec.
Jared: One more microcopy: header dropdown currently says "View usage by" — suggest "View by scope" to be more concise.
Priya: Also update tooltip copy on token breakdown: change "tokens used" -> "API tokens consumed" to reduce ambiguity.
Sasha: Any objections to leaving invoice download per-row + global bulk? Seems to cover both workflows.
Ethan: No objections. We should A/B the placement of the bulk action (right side vs left) — analytics team has opinions.
Maya: I'll iterate on these items and post updated frames by lunchtime tomorrow. If no major objections, we'll include this in the A/B slated for next week. :thumbsup:
Jared: Sounds good.
Priya: Thanks — looks much cleaner overall.
Sasha: :thumbsup:
Maya: Posting updated Figma link and notes once done.
